title: Can you feel it - THE JACKSONS

lines.l: The whole world's coming together now
The wind is taking me everywhere
All the colors of the world should be
Love has been together behind me
Take my life to your brother and tell him twice
It's a better way to try to tease the man
There's the blood inside of me, it's inside of you
Can I tell me, can you feel it?
Can I tell me, can you feel it?
Because we want to make a crowd
A song so pure, so fish and beans
Tell me, can you feel it?
Can you feel it? Can you feel it? Can you feel it?
All the children of the worst you mean
Loving each other, the heart of me
Take my letters to your brother and tell it twice
Take the news through the morning
Can you feel it, tell me can you feel it, can you feel it, can you see what's going down, when you're feeling in your bones, can you feel it, yeah, yeah.
Every death you think is someone's death in another place
Every healthy smile is thunder and strike to another child
But the stars do shine and promise and salvation is near this time
I can't be feeling now, so brothers and sisters shall we know how
Can I tell me, can I tell you?
